name: Chesma Shahi
description: Smallest but most beautiful Mughal garden built over a natural spring. Fresh spring water flows through terraces.

name: Dal Lake Floating Vegetable Market
description: Early morning floating market where vendors sell vegetables and flowers from shikaras. Starts at 5 AM.

name: Dal Lake Shikara Ride
description: Iconic wooden boat ride through floating gardens and houseboats. Sunset is magical.

name: Hazratbal Shrine
description: White marble mosque on the western shore of Dal Lake housing a relic believed to be a hair of Prophet Muhammad.

name: Indira Gandhi Memorial Tulip Garden
description: Asia's largest tulip garden with 1.5 million bulbs of 68 varieties. Open mid-March to mid-April only.

name: Jamia Masjid
description: Grand mosque built in 1394 with 370 wooden pillars of deodar wood. Can hold 33,333 worshippers.

name: Mughal Gardens
description: Three terraced gardens — Nishat, Shalimar, Chashme Shahi. 400-year-old Mughal landscaping.

name: Nishat Bagh
description: Largest Mughal garden in Kashmir with 12 terraces representing the 12 signs of zodiac. Dal Lake backdrop.

name: Pari Mahal
description: Seven-terraced garden built by Dara Shikoh as a Buddhist monastery, later converted to a library. Night-lit.

name: Shalimar Bagh
description: Emperor Jahangir's "Garden of Love" built in 1619. Terraced Mughal garden with fountains and chinars.

name: Shankaracharya Temple
description: Hilltop Shiva temple at 1,000 ft above Dal Lake dating to 200 BC. Panoramic views of Srinagar and Dal Lake.

name: Double Decker Living Root Bridge
description: Two-level bridge grown from rubber tree roots by Khasi people over centuries. UNESCO Tentative List.

name: Mawsmai Cave
description: Limestone cave with stalactites and stalagmites. Well-lit 150-meter walkthrough. Narrow passages.

name: Nohkalikai Falls
description: India's tallest plunge waterfall at 1,115 ft. Named after a tragic Khasi legend. Dramatic cliff-edge view.

name: Seven Sisters Falls
description: Seven separate waterfalls cascading down a cliff. Best viewed during monsoon season from Mawkdok.

name: Thangkharang Park
description: Park on a cliff edge with views of Bangladesh plains below. Fossils and rare orchids on display.

name: Chalal Village Trek
description: Easy 30-minute riverside trek from Kasol to Chalal village with cafés, mountain views, and Parvati River.

name: Kasol Riverside Cafés
description: Cluster of bohemian cafés along Parvati River. Known for Israeli food, live music, and mountain views.

name: Kheerganga Trek
description: Iconic 12 km trek through forests to natural hot springs at 9,700 ft. Camping under stars.

name: Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara
description: Sacred Sikh shrine with natural hot springs. Langar serves thousands daily. Hot springs used for cooking.

name: Bara Bazaar
description: Main market of Aizawl spread over a hillside. Traditional Mizo textiles, bamboo products, and local food.

name: Mizoram State Museum
description: Mizo tribal artifacts, traditional costumes, bamboo crafts, and historical exhibits.

name: Solomon's Temple
description: Striking white church modeled on Solomon's Temple in Jerusalem. Views over Aizawl city.

name: Chittorgarh Fort
description: Largest fort in India (692 acres). UNESCO World Heritage Site. Rani Padmini Palace, Vijay Stambh, Kirti Stambh.

name: Rani Padmini Palace
description: Lakeside palace associated with the legendary queen Padmini. Mirror chamber where Alauddin Khilji saw her reflection.

name: Vijay Stambh (Tower of Victory)
description: 37-meter tower built in 1448 by Rana Kumbha. Nine stories with intricate Hindu iconography.

name: Bhairavnath Temple
description: Guardian deity temple above Kedarnath. Trek to this spot offers spectacular views of the temple and valley.

name: Gandhi Sarovar (Chorabari Lake)
description: Glacial lake at 12,900 ft, 3 km from Kedarnath. Named after Mahatma Gandhi, whose ashes were immersed here.

name: Kedarnath Temple
description: One of the 12 Jyotirlingas, at 11,755 ft. Built by Adi Shankaracharya in 8th century. Survived 2013 floods.

name: Kala Dungar (Black Hill)
description: Highest point in Kutch at 462m. Views of the Rann and Pakistan border. Magnetic hill phenomenon on the road.

name: Rann Utsav Tent City
description: Luxury tent resort with cultural programs, live music, craft bazaar, ATV rides, and camel carts. Nov-Feb only.

name: White Rann (Great Rann)
description: Infinite white salt desert stretching to every horizon. Under full moon it glows like a frozen ocean. India's most surreal landscape.

name: Bandhavgarh Fort
description: Ancient fort inside the park dating to 2,000 years. 35-ft reclining Vishnu statue carved from rock.

name: Bandhavgarh Tiger Safari
description: Highest tiger density of any national park in India. Jeep and elephant safaris for tiger sighting.

name: Dhanaulti Eco Park
description: Two adjoining parks (Amber & Dhara) with adventure activities set in deodar forests at 7,600 ft.

name: Surkanda Devi Temple
description: Hilltop Shakti temple at 9,000 ft reached by a short trek. Panoramic views of snow-clad peaks.

name: Himalayan Nature Park (Kufri Zoo)
description: Home to Himalayan wildlife including snow leopard, musk deer, and pheasants at 7,990 ft.

name: Mahasu Peak
description: Highest point in Kufri at 8,563 ft. Panoramic views of Shimla, Kedarnath and Badrinath ranges on clear days.

name: Nalanda Archaeological Museum
description: Artifacts from Nalanda excavations — bronze statues, stone sculptures, manuscripts, and seals.

name: Nalanda University Ruins
description: UNESCO World Heritage site of the ancient Nalanda Mahavihara. World's first residential university (5th century).

name: Mandawa Castle
description: Heritage castle hotel in the heart of Shekhawati. Gateway to the painted haveli trail.

name: Painted Havelis of Shekhawati
description: Open-air art gallery of Rajasthan. Hundreds of havelis with frescoes in Mandawa, Nawalgarh, Fatehpur.

name: Achabal Garden
description: Mughal garden built by Empress Nur Jahan. Three terraces with cascading waterfalls and chinar trees.

name: Baba Baidyanath Temple
description: One of 12 Jyotirlingas and one of 51 Shakti Peethas. Massive pilgrimage during Shravan month.

name: Manas Tiger Reserve Safari
description: UNESCO World Heritage Site and Tiger Reserve. Golden langur, pygmy hog, and Bengal florican habitat.

name: Roopkund (Skeleton Lake)
description: Mysterious glacial lake at 16,500 ft with hundreds of ancient human skeletons visible when ice melts.
